item.title: Neural Expansion: A Unified Mechanism for Deep Network Generalization
item.description: Proposed Generalization Intervals framework explaining why more than 90% of correct predictions occur within directional stability regions defined by Jacobian singular values. This work provides a unified mechanism to understand how deep networks generalize to unseen data.

item.title: Robust Vision Transformers (ViTs) - Understanding and Mitigating Representation Vulnerabilities
item.description: Examined vulnerabilities in Vision Transformers (ViTs), revealing how small input changes affect layer-wise representations. Proposed NeuroShield-ViT to neutralize vulnerable neurons and enhance adversarial robustness. Improved classification accuracy by 54.85% against PGD attacks and 71.6% against IGO attacks on ImageNet1K.
